name: PARALLEL_MONITORING_TRACKS
hypothesis: MIDDLE atoms encode parallel monitoring parameters (not sequential steps). High-affinity atom pairs (C1210) are fused macro-atoms that compose in parallel.

predictions.T1_macro_atom: Macro-atom decomposition improves C1190 composition r significantly over individual atoms
predictions.T2_order_magnitude: Reversed MIDDLE pairs (same atoms, different order) have JSD ratio < 0.5 vs different-set pairs
predictions.T3_cross_token_coupling: SET carry MI >= TERMINAL->INITIAL MI (parallel) OR INITIAL->INITIAL comparable to TERMINAL->INITIAL
predictions.T4_atom_removal: Removing any single atom position produces roughly equal behavioral change (JSD ratio < 1.5)

falsifiers.T1: Macro-atom r <= individual atom r OR permutation p >= 0.05
falsifiers.T3: SET carry MI << TERMINAL->INITIAL MI AND INITIAL->INITIAL << TERMINAL->INITIAL
falsifiers.T4: One position dominates all others by ratio > 2.0
